meta.name: technical-blog-writing
meta.description: Technical blog post writing with structure, code examples, and developer audience conventions. Covers post types, code formatting, explanation depth, and developer-specific engagement patterns. Use for: engineering blogs, dev tutorials, technical writing, developer content, documentation posts. Triggers: technical blog, dev blog, engineering blog, technical writing, developer tutorial, tech post, code tutorial, programming blog, developer content, technical article, engineering post, coding tutorial, technical content

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 写出结构清晰、代码示例丰富的技术博客
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要撰写面向开发者的技术博客或教程
copy.tagline_en: Write structured technical blog posts with code examples
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write developer-focused technical blogs or tutorials

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照技术博客的规范写作，包括教程、深度分析、事故报告等类型。它会自动添加代码示例、图表，并遵循开发者友好的语气和结构。
howto.when: 当你要求写技术博客、开发教程、工程博客或技术文章时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一篇关于使用 Node.js 构建 REST API 的教程。
say.note: Claude 会生成带步骤、代码和解释的教程。

say.text: 写一篇关于我们如何将 API 延迟降低 90% 的深度分析。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含架构图、基准数据和权衡分析的文章。

say.text: 写一份关于昨天服务中断的事故报告。
say.note: Claude 会按时间线、根因分析和改进措施的结构输出。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude writes technical blog posts following developer conventions: tutorials, deep dives, postmortems, benchmarks, and architecture posts. It includes runnable code examples, diagrams, and uses a direct, honest tone.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a technical blog, dev tutorial, engineering blog, or technical article.

say_en.text: Write a tutorial on building a REST API with Node.js.
say_en.note: Claude generates a step-by-step tutorial with code.

say_en.text: Write a deep dive on how we reduced API latency by 90%.
say_en.note: Claude produces an article with diagrams, benchmarks, and trade-offs.

say_en.text: Write a postmortem for yesterday's service outage.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a timeline, root cause, and lessons learned.
